title: Lapse and Reinstatement of Spendable Wanderlane Traveller Club Points
content:
Spendable points on a Wanderlane Traveller Club card lapse at the end of the expiry term of the tier held when they were earned, counted from the date they posted. They lapse row by row so that the oldest points always leave first.

On a tier whose expiry extends with activity, any qualifying activity resets the clock on the whole balance rather than on the individual accrual.

## The reinstatement window

Lapsed points are reinstated only when frozen time is not after the moment the expiry sweep removed the points from the member's card plus the reinstatement window of the tier held. The sweep recorded against the membership is the authority for the moment the points were removed, and the window must still be open before the points are reinstated.

The reinstatement window is counted in whole calendar days from the day of the sweep, weekends and public holidays included, and a request made exactly on the closing day is still in time.

| The day the reinstatement is asked for | Inside the window |
|---|---|
| The day of the sweep itself | Yes |
| Any day after the sweep and before the closing day | Yes |
| The closing day | Yes |
| The day after the closing day | No |

The closing day is the day of the sweep advanced by the reinstatement window of the tier held. Where that window is 0 calendar days, the closing day is the day of the sweep itself.

## What reinstatement costs

Reinstatement carries the reinstatement fee of the tier held at the time of the request, and a tier whose fee is zero reinstates free of charge. The two tier figures in play are read at different moments: the expiry term is that of the tier held when the points were earned, and the reinstatement fee is that of the tier held when the reinstatement is asked for.

## A membership that falls dormant

A membership that lapses for inactivity sweeps its whole spendable balance in one movement, and those points are reinstated only if the membership itself is reinstated first.

## Qualifying points

Qualifying points never lapse. They are cleared down when the period ends and are never swept for age.
